# Bundled xterm.js Assets

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0

The corresponding MIT license texts are stored as `LICENSE.xterm` and
`LICENSE.addon-fit`. These files are served only by the loopback-bound private
terminal so its Content Security Policy remains self-contained.
